item.text:
Refactored [BalancedParentheses.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BalancedParentheses.java:1) to model bracket types explicitly with a private `BracketPair` enum. The validator now pushes and compares bracket kinds instead of raw chars plus separate lookup collections, which makes the matching rules local to one type and removes the previous split between `Map`/`Set` helpers.

I also simplified [BalancedParenthesesTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BalancedParenthesesTest.java:1) into a single parameterized table of input plus expected result. That keeps all behavior cases in one place and makes adding new scenarios straightforward.

Verified with the JUnit console run:

